description_en: Configures the protection rule group used by the regular expression protection engine for a specified domain name. In addition to the three system default protection rule groups, you can also select a custom rule group
description_zh: 为指定域名配置选择正则防护引擎使用的防护规则组，除系统默认的三种防护规则组外，也可以选择自定义规则组
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi set-domain-rule-group --domains www.aliyundoc.com --rule-group-id 1012 --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDomainRuleGroup

parameters.help_en:
The list of domain names for which you want to configure the protection rule group. Specify the value as a string converted from an array.

You can specify multiple domain names at a time in the following format: `["<Domain name 1>","<Domain name 2>",...]`.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html to query all domain names that have been added to WAF for protection
parameters.help_zh:
要设置防护规则组的域名列表。使用数组转化的字符串格式表示。

支持同时设置多个域名，格式：`["<域名1>","<域名2>",……]`。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html查询所有已接入WAF防护的域名
parameters.name: domains

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protection rule group to apply to the rule-based protection engine. Valid values:

1011: the built-in Strict rule group of WAF.
1012: the built-in Medium rule group of WAF.
1013: the built-in Loose rule group of WAF.

In addition to the built-in rule groups listed above, you can also specify the ID of a custom rule group.

You can obtain the ID of a custom rule group on the Protection Rule Group page in the Web Application Firewall console (https://yundun.console.aliyun.com/?p=wafnext)
parameters.help_zh:
为规则防护引擎设置要应用的防护规则组ID。取值：

1011：表示WAF内置的严格规则组。
1012：表示WAF内置的中等规则组。
1013：表示WAF内置的宽松规则组。

除了以上内置规则组外，您还可以设置自定义规则组的ID。

您可以在Web应用防火墙控制台 (https://yundun.console.aliyun.com/?p=wafnext)的防护规则组页面，获取自定义规则组的ID
parameters.name: rule_group_id

parameters.help_en: The version number for the current configuration, which is used for optimistic locking control
parameters.help_zh: 为当前配置设置一个版本号（用于实现乐观锁控制）
parameters.name: waf_version

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the domain name belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
网站域名在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the intelligent rule hosting feature. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1 (default): enabled.

Intelligent rule hosting means that WAF intelligently learns the behavior patterns of historical business traffic, identifies protection rules that may cause false positives for normal business, and automatically configures web intrusion protection whitelists to block the corresponding protection rules in specific business protection scenarios. After the false positive risk is eliminated, the blocked protection rules are restored
parameters.help_zh:
设置智能规则托管功能的启用状态。取值：
0：表示关闭。
1（默认）：表示开启。

智能规则托管表示由WAF智能学习历史业务流量的行为模式，识别可能对正常业务产生误拦截的防护规则，并通过自动设置Web入侵防护白名单，在特定业务防护场景下屏蔽对应防护规则。等误报风险消除后，再恢复使用被屏蔽的防护规则
parameters.name: waf_ai_status

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
